source.candidateCommitPolicy: Replace borrowed implementation names with responsibility-based memory and external-reference names; keep historical configuration/deduplication/snapshots and upstream attribution. Source verification is separate from installation and foreground acceptance.

dispositions.delete_old_implementation: Remove the old resource path after verifying consumers.
dispositions.other_work_not_in_release: Preserve unrelated work outside this candidate.

product_naming.description: Product naming cleanup, compatible memory identities, generated contracts and reference packaging.
